{{short description|American mathematician at Purdue University}}
'''Patricia E. Bauman''' is an American mathematician who studies [[partial differential equation]]s that model the behavior of [[liquid crystal]]s and [[superconductor]]s.<ref name=mathalliance/> She is a professor of mathematics at [[Purdue University]].<ref name="purdue">{{cite web | author=  | title=- Department of Mathematics, Purdue University | website=Department of Mathematics, Purdue University | url=http://www.math.purdue.edu/people/bio/bauman | access-date=2019-07-02}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Bauman received her Ph.D. from the [[University of Minnesota]] in 1982, under the supervision of Eugene Fabes; her dissertation was ''Properties of Non-Negative Solutions of Second-Order Elliptic Equations and their Adjoints''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=1842|title=Patricia E. Bauman}}</ref> She was a postdoctoral researcher at the [[Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences]] and a [[C. L. E. Moore instructor]] of mathematics at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] before joining the Purdue University faculty.<ref name=mathalliance>{{cite web|url=https://mathalliance.org/mentor/patricia-bauman/|title=Patricia Bauman|publisher=Math Alliance|accessdate=2020-06-17}}</ref>

==Recognition==
Bauman was given an [[AMS Centennial Fellowship]] for 1994 to 1995.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ams.org/prizes-awards/pabrowse.cgi?purl=centennial-fellow|title=AMS Centennial Fellowships|publisher=American Mathematical Society|accessdate=2020-06-17}}</ref> In 2012, Bauman became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref>

She was elected chair of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] Activity Group on Mathematical Aspects of Materials Science (SIAG/MS) for 2017–2019.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.purdue.edu/math-news/math/news/2017/BaumanSIAMMaterialsGroup.html|title=Prof. Bauman elected chair of SIAM Activity Group|publisher=Purdue Department of Mathematics|accessdate=2020-06-17|date=January 25, 2017}}</ref> She is a former AMS Council member at large.<ref>{{Cite web |title=AMS Committees |url=http://www.ams.org/about-us/governance/committees/mal-past.html |access-date=2023-03-27 |website=American Mathematical Society |language=en}}</ref>
